title: A Bipartite Graph with a Nonunimodal Acyclic Polynomial
summary: We construct a bipartite graph on 230 vertices whose acyclic polynomial, which enumerates vertex subsets inducing forests, is not unimodal. This answers Question 3.3 of Barton, Brown, and Pike negatively. The graph has a common set of 50 vertices and 15 branches, each with two sets of six vertices. A partition according to the number of selected common vertices gives a three-term formula for the complete induced-forest polynomial.
